---
title: "Talks and posters"
listing:
  contents:
    - "*/index.qmd"
    - "../blog/*/index.qmd"
  # blog posts appear here only if they have an `event:` field
  include:
    event: "*"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: table
  fields: [date, title, event]
  field-display-names:
    event: "Event"
  date-format: "MMM YYYY"
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  table-hover: true
---

Slides, posters and write-ups, newest first. Most of the code behind them is on [GitHub](https://github.com/nikotinz).
